answer.reason: The verses tell two distinct deeds of Jonathan: carrying word to David during Absalom's revolt and bringing Adonijah the news of Solomon's kingship.

clauses.english: carried word to David of Ahithophel's counsel and escaped Absalom's servants
clauses.quote: they went and told king David

clauses.english: told Adonijah that David had made Solomon king
clauses.quote: our lord king David hath made Solomon king
